svg.aria-label: The cover of Democratizing Linux: A Pipe Dream. On a snowy night a penguin in a nightcap sleeps, and its dream is seen through the open end of a large steel pipe: a sunny hill where a penguin waves beside a desktop computer, under the words the year of the Linux desktop, with the years 1999, 2009 and 2019 struck out. Next to the sleeper a dumpster labelled teraSlop is on fire, with a cracked four-pane window and a blue error screen sticking out of it, and a crab toasts a marshmallow over the flames. A sign shows the evolution of teraSlop: spyware, vapourware, bloatware, and fire.
